people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Then Jesus said to him, “Put your sword back into its place, for all those who take the sword will die by the sword.
translations.bsb: “Put your sword back in its place,” Jesus said to him. “For all who draw the sword will die by the sword.
translations.kjv: Then said Jesus unto him, Put up again thy sword into his place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.
translations.asv: Then saith Jesus unto him, Put up again thy sword into its place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.
